content.rendered:
We are excited to continue our partnership with EPI (Educational Products, Inc.) for providing our 2021-2022 school packs. If you would like to have your students supplies waiting for them at school ready to go, this is for you. Through our school we are able to save up to 40% on school supplies through EPI and we are passing along this direct savings to you. This helps you save time any money. You can contact Michelle Webb at ustwowebbs@yahoo.com with any questions. The deadline to place your order for the supply packs is June 13, 2021.

To order your box:

go to: https://www.educationalproducts.com/shoppacks and enter our school code MID115 to place your order.

Supply packs will be delivered to your child’s classroom or pod in time for Middleton’s Supply Night.

If you would prefer to shop for your supplies we have a supply list you can request from the school.
